画面里最主要的东西是什么？: What is the main thing in the picture?
主体是整张图的锚点。先说清楚它，后面那些风格、光线才有意义。: The subject is the anchor of the whole image. Nail it down first; only then do style and lighting mean anything.
画面主体是人物: the main subject is a person
画面主体是动物: the main subject is an animal
画面主体是产品静物: the main subject is a product still life
画面主体是环境场景，没有突出的人物: the main subject is an environment or scene, with no prominent person in it
画面主体是建筑空间，需要体现结构与透视关系: the main subject is architectural space, and the structure and perspective need to read clearly
画面主体是食物，需要突出色泽与诱人的质感: the main subject is food, and its colour and appetising texture need to come through
画面主体是机械载具，需要体现结构细节与金属质感: the main subject is a machine or vehicle, and its structural detail and metallic surfaces need to show
画面主体是抽象概念的可视化表达，不追求具象写实: the main subject is a visualisation of an abstract concept, not a literal depiction
这个人物的感觉更接近哪一种？: Which of these is closest to how the person should come across?
像真实拍出来的: Looks like it was really photographed
写实自然的人物形象，皮肤有真实纹理，表情放松不造作: a realistic, natural person with true skin texture and a relaxed, unposed expression
人物正在专注地做某件事，带有抓拍的瞬间感与故事性: the person is absorbed in doing something, with the candid immediacy of a snapshot
时尚杂志大片质感，造型有设计感，姿态有张力: fashion-magazine editorial quality, deliberately styled, posed with tension
二次元角色风格，线条清晰，配色明亮: an anime character style with clean linework and a bright palette
画面中有多个人物，需要处理好彼此的位置关系与视线交互: several people in the frame, with their positions and eyelines carefully related to one another
动物以什么状态出现？: In what state should the animal appear?
想让人想摸: Makes you want to reach out
可爱的宠物形象，毛发柔软蓬松，眼神有神: an adorable pet with soft, fluffy fur and bright, lively eyes
野生动物纪实感，体现动物的力量与自然环境: a wildlife-documentary look that conveys the animal's power and its natural habitat
拟人化的动物形象，穿着衣物或从事人类活动，带幽默感: an anthropomorphic animal wearing clothes or doing human things, with a sense of humour
经过艺术化处理的动物形象，不追求写实: an artistically treated animal, not aiming for realism
产品怎么展示？: How should the product be shown?
纯净单色背景，产品居中，光线均匀，没有多余元素: a clean single-colour background, the product centred, even lighting, nothing else in frame
产品融入真实使用场景，通过环境暗示它的用途与调性: the product set into a real situation, with the surroundings hinting at what it is for and how it should feel
近距离特写，重点呈现产品的材质、纹理与做工细节: a tight close-up focused on the product's material, texture and build quality
概念化的产品海报，用有创意的视觉设定表达产品主张: a conceptual product poster that expresses the product's idea through a creative visual conceit
镜头离主体多远？怎么取景？: How far is the camera from the subject, and how is it framed?
景别决定了信息量 —— 特写讲细节，全景讲关系。: Shot size decides how much information you get — close-ups are about detail, wide shots about relationships.
只拍局部，强调细节: Part of it only, detail first
特写构图，主体占据画面大部分面积: a close-up framing with the subject filling most of the frame
中景构图，主体完整呈现并保留适度的环境信息: a medium framing that shows the subject whole while keeping a moderate amount of surroundings
全景构图，环境占主导，主体在场景中只占较小比例: a wide framing where the environment dominates and the subject takes up only a small part of the scene
微距特写，极近距离呈现表面纹理与微小细节: a macro close-up at extreme range, revealing surface texture and minute detail
对称居中构图，画面左右平衡，视觉重心落在正中: a symmetrical, centred composition, balanced left and right, with the visual weight dead centre
三分法构图，主体位于画面的黄金分割点上: a rule-of-thirds composition with the subject sitting on a golden-section point
画面大面积留白，主体偏置，为文字排版预留空间: large areas of negative space with the subject off-centre, leaving room to set text
从什么角度去看？: From what angle do we look at it?
平视视角，接近人眼高度: an eye-level view, close to human height
低角度仰拍，主体显得高大有压迫感: a low angle shot from below, making the subject look tall and imposing
高角度俯拍，呈现全局关系: a high angle shot from above that shows how everything relates
倾斜的荷兰角构图，带来轻微的不稳定感: a tilted Dutch-angle composition that adds a slight sense of instability
第一人称视角，像观看者亲眼所见: a first-person viewpoint, as if seen through the viewer's own eyes
航拍俯瞰视角，强调地形与空间格局: an aerial overhead view that emphasises terrain and spatial layout
过肩或背身视角，用前景人物引导视线看向画面深处: an over-the-shoulder or from-behind view that uses a foreground figure to lead the eye into the depth of the frame
光是画面里最贵的东西。同一张构图，换一种光就是另一个故事。: Light is the most expensive thing in a picture. Same composition, different light, a different story.
柔和均匀的自然光，阴影过渡平缓: soft, even natural light with gentle shadow transitions
黄金时刻的低角度暖光，画面泛着金橙色: low golden-hour light, the frame washed in gold and orange
蓝调时刻的冷色环境光，整体偏青蓝: cool blue-hour ambient light, the whole frame tending cyan-blue
强烈的侧逆光，在主体边缘勾出明亮的轮廓线: strong side backlight drawing a bright rim along the subject's edge
影棚布光，主光与辅光层次分明，背景干净: studio lighting with a clear key-and-fill hierarchy against a clean background
硬质直射光，阴影边缘锐利，明暗对比强烈: hard direct light with sharp shadow edges and strong light-dark contrast
霓虹灯与彩色人造光源，画面有强烈的色彩反射: neon and coloured artificial sources throwing strong colour reflections across the frame
低调照明，画面以暗部为主，只有局部被点亮: low-key lighting, the frame mostly in shadow with only a local area lit
高调照明，画面明亮通透，几乎没有浓重阴影: high-key lighting, bright and airy with almost no heavy shadow
体积光效果，空气中可见清晰的光束与尘埃颗粒: a volumetric light effect with visible beams and dust motes hanging in the air
你想要哪种视觉风格？: Which visual style do you want?
最多选两个。画法只能选一种，氛围感可以叠加（比如「写实摄影 + 电影感」）。: Two at most. You can only pick one rendering style, but a mood can be layered on top — photographic realism plus a cinematic feel, say.
写实摄影风格，光影与质感符合真实物理: a photographic-realism style where light and material behave the way they really do
电影画面质感，胶片色彩，高动态范围: a cinematic look with film-stock colour and high dynamic range
日系清新风格，高亮度低对比，通透干净: a light Japanese style: high brightness, low contrast, clean and airy
中国水墨风格，讲究留白与写意，笔触有呼吸感: a Chinese ink-wash style that values empty space and expressive suggestion, with brushwork that breathes
三维渲染质感，材质与光线符合物理渲染规律: a 3D render where materials and light follow physically based rendering
赛博朋克风格，霓虹光污染与高科技低生活的视觉反差: a cyberpunk style: neon light pollution set against the visual contrast of high tech and low life
复古胶片质感，明显颗粒，色彩略微褪色: a vintage film look with visible grain and slightly faded colour
极简扁平插画风格，几何化造型，色彩块面分明: a minimal flat illustration style with geometric shapes and clearly separated blocks of colour
油画厚涂质感，笔触清晰可辨，颜色层叠丰富: oil paint laid on thickly, brushstrokes clearly readable, colour layered richly
概念艺术风格，强调设计感与想象力的表达: a concept-art style that emphasises design sensibility and imagination
像素艺术风格，色块明确，边缘锐利: a pixel-art style with distinct colour blocks and hard edges
蒸汽波风格，粉紫渐变配色，融合八十年代怀旧科技元素: a vaporwave style with pink-and-purple gradients and nostalgic 1980s tech imagery
这张图要传递什么情绪？: What feeling should this image carry?
氛围决定了观众「感觉到什么」，而不只是「看到什么」。: Mood decides what the audience feels, not merely what it sees.
整体氛围宁静放松，节奏舒缓: an overall mood of calm and relaxation, unhurried
氛围温暖治愈，让人感到被包裹的安全感: a warm, comforting mood that feels like being held
氛围紧张压抑，带有不安的张力: a tense, oppressive mood with an uneasy charge
氛围孤独疏离，主体与环境之间存在明显的距离感: a lonely, detached mood with a clear distance between the subject and its surroundings
氛围神秘，画面中似乎隐藏着尚未揭示的信息: a mysterious mood, as though the frame holds something not yet revealed
氛围充满活力与能量，动感强烈: a mood full of energy and drive, strongly kinetic
氛围高级克制，用留白与质感说话，不靠元素堆砌: a refined, restrained mood that speaks through empty space and material quality rather than piling on elements
氛围怀旧复古，带有年代感与记忆的温度: a nostalgic mood carrying a sense of era and the warmth of memory
整体色彩倾向是什么？: What is the overall colour bias?
基调只能有一个，不然画面会花。: Pick one. Two key colours and the frame turns muddy.
以暖色为主，橙黄红构成主色相: warm-led, with orange, yellow and red as the dominant hues
以冷色为主，青蓝色构成主色相: cool-led, with cyan and blue as the dominant hues
低饱和度配色，接近单色调: a low-saturation palette, close to monochrome
莫兰迪色系，灰调柔和，色彩之间互相谦让: a Morandi palette: soft greyed tones in which the colours defer to one another
高饱和度撞色搭配，色彩对比强烈: high-saturation clashing colours with strong contrast
黑白影调，只靠明暗层次塑造画面: a black-and-white tonality that shapes the image purely through light and dark
复古褪色色调，色彩像被时间洗过: a faded vintage tonality, as though time had washed the colour out
冷暖双色对比，画面在两种色相之间形成张力: a warm-cool duotone, the frame held in tension between two hues
这张图准备用在哪里？: Where will this image be used?
比例不对，再好的图也得裁。: Get the ratio wrong and even a great image ends up cropped.
21:9 超宽画幅，接近电影银幕比例: a 21:9 ultra-wide frame, close to cinema screen proportions
要什么级别的细节和镜头质感？: What level of detail and lens character do you want?
这一块决定成图「贵不贵」。: This is the part that decides whether an image looks expensive.
极高细节，材质纹理清晰可辨，经得起放大观看: extremely high detail, with materials and texture still clearly readable when magnified
浅景深效果，背景柔和虚化，主体从环境中剥离出来: a shallow depth of field with the background softly blurred, lifting the subject clear of its surroundings
85mm 中长焦人像镜头质感，空间压缩自然，人脸比例舒服: the character of an 85mm short-telephoto portrait lens: natural compression and flattering facial proportions
24mm 广角镜头质感，透视夸张，空间纵深感强: the character of a 24mm wide lens: exaggerated perspective and deep spatial recession
长曝光效果，运动的物体留下柔和的拖影: a long-exposure effect in which moving objects leave soft trails
明显的胶片颗粒质感，画面不追求绝对干净: noticeable film grain, with no attempt to be spotless
真实的皮肤质感，保留毛孔与细微瑕疵，不做过度磨皮: real skin texture with pores and small imperfections intact, no over-smoothing
有哪些东西绝对不要出现在画面里？: What must never appear in the image?
负面提示词是最省力的提效手段。一个都不选也可以。: A negative prompt is the cheapest way to raise quality. You can also skip it entirely.
